reviews.comment:
Ubicado a metros del control Argentino en la rotonda de la RP1 (que va al Hito 1 a 90 kms) y la RN3 es parada obligatoria para cargar Nafta o descansar, ya que por el clima o el trafico, los 70 kms que separan de Rio Grande pueden jugar una mala pasada para los viajeros. Si salen desde Rio Gallegos, llevar Efectivo ya que a veces no esta disponible el cobro con Tarjeta de debido / crédito, a su vez que el motel solo cuenta con 8 habitaciones, por lo que hagan la reserva. A Agosto 2022 la habitación doble está entre $2500 y $4000 la noche (descuento para socios). Destacable el servicio del comedor. Un lujo. A su vez si el clima lo permite se puede disfrutar del amanecer en la playa que esta a 400 mts.

(Translated by Google)
Located just meters from the Argentine checkpoint at the roundabout of Provincial Route 1 (which leads to Milestone 1, 90 km away) and National Route 3, this motel is a must-stop for refueling or resting. The 70 km drive to Rio Grande can be challenging for travelers, especially given the weather and traffic. If you're coming from Rio Gallegos, bring cash, as debit/credit card payments are sometimes unavailable. The motel only has 8 rooms, so reservations are recommended. As of August 2022, a double room costs between $2500 and $4000 per night (with a discount for members). The dining service is outstanding—a real treat. Weather permitting, you can also enjoy the sunrise on the beach, which is just 400 meters away.
